name: Mark Courier Details
query: SELECT CONCAT( '', dr.name, '' ) AS `Register Number:HTML:165`, dr.date_time AS `Date:Date:105`, dr.posting__time AS `Time:Time:90`, drr.delivery_note AS `Delivery Note:Link/Delivery Note:175`, drr.customer_name AS `Customer:Data:180`, drr.driver_name AS `Driver Name:Data:150`, drr.vehicle_number AS `Vehicle Number:Data:130`, drr.telephone AS `Telephone:Data:135`, drr.number_of_bundles AS `Bundles:Int:85`, drr.total_expense AS `Total Expense:Currency:125`, drr.row_status AS `Status:Data:100`, dr.submitted_by AS `Submitted By:Link/User:180` FROM `tabDispatch Register` dr INNER JOIN `tabDispatch Register Row` drr ON drr.parent = dr.name AND drr.parenttype = 'Dispatch Register' AND drr.parentfield = 'rows' WHERE dr.docstatus = 1 AND dr.date_time BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s ORDER BY dr.date_time DESC, dr.posting__time DESC, dr.name DESC, drr.idx ASC
